content.title: Parent Academy
content.summary: The Arvada Police Department, in collaboration with Jeffco Public Schools, is hosting a free two-part Parent Academy on November 11 and 12, 2025, aimed at educating parents and guardians of middle and high school students about contemporary challenges their children face. The sessions will cover topics such as substance abuse, online safety, and mental health, and will include interactive resources like a mock teen bedroom to help parents identify potential warning signs. Registration is required, and childcare will be provided for potty-trained children ages 3 and up.
content.body:
Raising teens in today’s world isn’t easy, and the Arvada Police Department is here to help! Organized in collaboration with Jeffco Public Schools, the Parent Academy is a two-part, no-cost educational event designed specifically for parents and guardians of Jeffco middle and high school students. This program aims to give parents the tools, knowledge, and confidence to better understand the complex challenges their children are navigating today.

Please note: This event is intended for parents and guardians only. Some of the topics covered will discuss how students may intentionally bypass safety efforts at home or school, and are not appropriate for a student audience.

- **When:** Tuesday, November 11 and Wednesday, November 12, 2025, from 5:30 pm to 9:00 pm.
- **Where:** Arvada West High School, 11595 Allendale Drive, Arvada
- **Why:** This is your chance to learn directly from officers, educators, and health professionals about the issues impacting your child’s safety, health, and future.

## Session Topics

### Tuesday, November 11

- Current Drugs of Abuse & Emerging Trends (Spotlight on THC use and abuse in teens)
- Dating & Sexual Violence Awareness and Prevention

### Wednesday, November 12

- Social Media, Online Safety & Digital Citizenship
- Student Mental Health, Self-Harm Awareness & Suicide Prevention

## Interactive Resources & Exhibits

### Mock Teen Bedroom Experience

What are you missing in plain sight? As part of the Parent Academy, parents will have the opportunity to explore our School Services Trailer, transformed into a realistic mock teenager’s bedroom. This interactive exhibit is designed to help parents recognize potential warning signs of risky or dangerous behavior that may be hidden in everyday spaces.

- Tuesday, November 11: Following the session on substance use, the bedroom will be set up as a scavenger hunt for signs of drug use and abuse. Parents will be challenged to identify items or hiding places commonly used by teens to conceal substances or paraphernalia.
- Wednesday, November 12: In alignment with the discussion on youth mental health, the bedroom will highlight indicators of self-harm and suicidal ideation. Parents will learn what to look for, what might be cause for concern, and how to start a conversation if they spot potential red flags.

### Partners and Resources

Each evening concludes with interactive displays and resource tables to help connect families to services and support networks in the community. Partners and resource tables include:

- APD Impaired Driving Awareness and Prevention
- Arvada Fire: Teen Arson Prevention & Teen Specific Safety Considerations
- Jeffco Public Schools Social Workers, Counselors, and Behavioral Intervention Staff
- Jeffco Public School R-1 Security
- Safe2Tell & Colorado Attorney General’s Office
- Colorado Information Analysis Center: Targeted Violence Prevention
- Warren Tech and other Career & Technical Education Programs
- School Resource Officer Unit Outreach (from multiple agencies)
- Jefferson Center for Mental Health
- Arvada City Attorney’s Office and Probation
- Jefferson County District Attorney's Office - Juvenile Division
- Juvenile Assessment Center

## Registration and Questions

Snacks and refreshments will be provided. Childcare will be provided (by high school volunteers) on a first-come, first-served basis for children ages 3+ who are fully potty-trained.

Registration is required, please sign up to attend by [completing this online form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=zMITxcUM0EWOaKxOpL1-GM-ne3hVKFtCkRZ1etiv-ihUMU9GOFBRNkRWRUtVOUpUNk9MMkhYQ09ZSS4u&route=shorturl).

If you would like to know more about the Parent Academy, please contact School Resource Officer Craig Smith at 303-435-4179, or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#610213120c081509210013170005004f0e1306).
